Dear Sir, 
 
Sub: Audio Recording of Earnings Call for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 
 
This is in furtherance of our letters dated October 15, 2026, and October 27, 2026, wherein intimations to 
host an Earnings Call on October 28, 2026, and an investor presentation arising thereto were provided, 
respectively. 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Para A of Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, the audio recording of the said Earnings Call is available on 
the weblink Q2_FY2026-2027_Financial Results_Audio at the Company’s website. 
 
You can also access the audio recording by clicking on the link below (Record ID: 10047848) 
https://ccreservations.com/recordings/select_recordings.php 
 
Please take the above information on record. 
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours faithfully, 
For UNITED BREWERIES LIMITED
